base.description: The g4poc FP8 base = PA's r03 (BASELINE-FP8.md, jumanzii/g4poc-a ac6035c07f): text-only compressed-tensors FP8 checkpoint (G4POC_MODEL_DIR default), FP8 KV, Triton attention + Triton fused_moe (default config), chunked prefill 4096. Same flags as baseline/serve.sh r03; PA launched from e3e4acf268, whose python/ is identical to this commit.

nvfp4-smoke.description: Harness smoke only (2026-10-04, coordinator-approved while the FP8 base is not up): gemma4nv's NVFP4 base, run with G4POC_MODEL_DIR at the NVFP4 snapshot. Never a g4poc result.

c1-moe-tuned.description: C1: base + a fused_moe Triton config tuned on the bs2 RTX 5090 (fp8_w8a8 per-channel, E=128, N=704; compute/moe_tune.py, merged by compute/merge_moe_configs.py). Only the MoE tile configs change. Config file: experiments/g4poc/compute/moe-configs/c1/configs/triton_3_7_1/E=128,N=704,device_name=NVIDIA_GeForce_RTX_5090,dtype=fp8_w8a8,per_channel_quant=True.json (sha256 b3bcce12...9576); on a host, SGLANG_MOE_CONFIG_DIR is a copy of experiments/g4poc/compute/moe-configs/c1 at /data/jooman/g4poc/moe-configs/c1.

c3-lpm.description: C3a: base + --schedule-policy lpm (longest cached prefix first among waiting requests; fcfs on the base). Scheduling order only; only matters when requests queue, i.e. from about 16 in flight on the base.

c3-cp2048.description: C3b: base + --chunked-prefill-size 2048 (4096 on the base). Halves the per-forward prefill tokens and the prefill activation transient; the KV pool is unchanged at mem 0.93.

c2-extend-tiles.description: C2-A: base + the sm120 FP8-KV Triton extend tiles (SGLANG_OPT_TRITON_EXTEND_SM120_FP8_KV_TILES=1; table from compute/extend_attn_bench.py: head_dim 512 (32, 32, 64, 8, 1), 256 (32, 32, 32, 4, 1)). Python differs from base's commit only in extend_attention.py and environ.py; with the env off it runs the base's tiles.

c2-extend-tiles-exact.description: C2-A fallback: like c2-extend-tiles but the table keeps the default KV tile widths (head_dim 512 (16, 32, 32, 4, 1), 256 (32, 64, 64, 8, 1); branch jumanzii/g4poc-b-c2exact), so outputs match the default tiles on the swept shapes.

final-mem-c1-c2a.description: bs2 final: PC's mem-final (memory/refs.json, d56fb9764a: stack1 flags, L8 FP8 vocab table, decode graphs to 48, expandable segments) + C1 tuned fused_moe config + C2-A sm120 FP8-KV extend tiles. Tree 1425761173 = mem-final's 53752c62aa + the C2-A tile commits (branch jumanzii/g4poc-final-c2). Config file: experiments/g4poc/compute/moe-configs/c1/configs/triton_3_7_1/E=128,N=704,device_name=NVIDIA_GeForce_RTX_5090,dtype=fp8_w8a8,per_channel_quant=True.json (sha256 b3bcce12...9576); on a host, SGLANG_MOE_CONFIG_DIR is a copy of experiments/g4poc/compute/moe-configs/c1 at /data/jooman/g4poc/moe-configs/c1.

final-mem-c1-c2a-nocache.description: Fleet model input, not a candidate: final-mem-c1-c2a with the radix cache off, so every turn re-prefills its whole history (the policy where idle sessions' histories fall out of the device pool). Max running 24 (the sweep stops at 20 in flight): without the radix cache SGLang sizes the sliding pool from max running requests, and 64 leaves no room for the full pool (82K-token SWA cap, start aborted 10-05 21:08).

final-hc-hc6.description: HS1' (host-RAM sizing slope, compute/PREREG.md): final-hc with a 6 GB host pool instead of 12 (--hicache-size 6), i.e. a storage bound of ~54 histories per GPU instead of ~77. Run in a 28G scope.
